full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Health and Welfare and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 19, 2010>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (82) Omitted.

(83) The Enforcement Rules of the Act on Encouragement and Support for Filial Piety are partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, in the portion other than the subparagraphs, "Minister of Health, Welfare and Family Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Health and Welfare".

(84) Omitted.
